## Description {#details}

<p>A 32-bit type reference.</p>


<p>Types are indexed by their order of appearance in .debug$T plus 0x1000. <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/type">Type</a> indices less than 0x1000 are "simple" types, composed of a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/codeview/#a9a5c54ae452fcc89ddc0c8d9b7b46caa">SimpleTypeMode</a> byte followed by a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/codeview/#a9cf141c9194799e2fa2d92de4c6e8ff0">SimpleTypeKind</a> byte.</p>


<p>Definition at line 96 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/debuginfo/include/llvm/debuginfo/codeview/typeindex-h">TypeIndex.h</a>.</p>
